notes.title: 🌿 Now available on iPad 🌱
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=ockUHQ45xwk;full][/previewyoutube]

Five Years Old Memories is now available for the iPad!
Some of the interactions are different from those of the Mac/PC version and offer a sensory experience unique to tablets. Like touching a picture with your finger...
If you have an iPad, please check it out🙌

App Store(iPad)▶https://apps.apple.com/app/five-years-old-memories/id1643670905

* Excluding some countries and regions(EU and mainland China)

notes.title: ✨ Five Years Old Memories is out now! ✨
notes.notes:
Hi!
This work that I’ve been working on since the summer of 2022 has been released.

[previewyoutube=wFgfmoq7ykA;full][/previewyoutube]

The seven friends who were the origin of fantastic episodes,
Natsumi-san who created music that is both playful and relaxing,
Hayakawa-kun who has been working with me for a long time on programming and developing ideas.
So many thanks to them, now it has taken shape. 
Thanks to ICC for giving me the opportunity to create and exhibit this, and my friends for testing it during the development!

The iPad version will be released in no time as long as this hot summer lasts just a bit longer.

See you later in my game🌞
From Komitsu
